name: McClintock 1950 mutable loci in maize
use_en: Describes the origin and behaviour of mutable loci in maize; a founding paper for mobile DNA.
use_zh: 描述玉米中可变位点的起源和行为，是可移动 DNA 的奠基文献之一。
note: Ac/Ds names in this paper [待确认]; not re-read for wording.

name: McClintock 1953 instability at selected maize loci
use_en: Reports induction of instability at selected loci in maize.
use_zh: 报道在选定玉米位点上诱导不稳定性。

name: McClintock 1984 genome responses to challenge
use_en: Published form of her lecture after the 1983 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for mobile genetic elements.
use_zh: 1983 年因发现可移动遗传元件获诺贝尔奖后的讲演稿。
note: Nobel year is a historical fact; this row is the 1984 Science paper.

name: Jordan, Saedler and Starlinger 1968 gal insertion mutations
use_en: Showed that certain strong-polar mutations in the E. coli gal operon were insertions.
use_zh: 表明大肠杆菌 gal 操纵子中某些强极性突变是插入造成的。

name: Shapiro 1979 transposition model
use_en: Molecular model for transposition and replication of bacteriophage Mu and other transposable elements.
use_zh: 为噬菌体 Mu 及其他转座元件的转座和复制提出分子模型。

name: Mahillon and Chandler 1998 insertion sequences
use_en: Review of bacterial insertion sequences (IS elements).
use_zh: 细菌插入序列（IS 元件）综述。

name: Boeke et al. 1985 Ty RNA intermediate
use_en: A key direct demonstration that yeast Ty elements transpose through an RNA intermediate.
use_zh: 酵母 Ty 元件通过 RNA 中间体转座的一项关键直接证明。

name: Kidwell, Kidwell and Sved 1977 hybrid dysgenesis
use_en: Describes hybrid dysgenesis in Drosophila melanogaster, including mutation, sterility and male recombination.
use_zh: 描述黑腹果蝇的杂交衰退，包括突变、不育和雄性重组。

name: Bingham, Kidwell and Rubin 1982 P element
use_en: Results strongly supported the P-factor hypothesis: that P elements are the molecular basis of P-M hybrid dysgenesis.
use_zh: 结果有力支持 P 因子假说：P 元件是 P-M hybrid dysgenesis（杂交衰退，中文定名 [待确认]）的分子基础。

name: Thomas 1971 genetic organization of chromosomes
use_en: Discusses the genetic organisation of chromosomes in the context of widely varying genome DNA content.
use_zh: 在基因组 DNA 含量差异很大的背景下讨论染色体的遗传组织。
note: Secondary sources attribute the phrase C-value paradox to this paper; the Thomas text itself was not re-read here [待确认].

name: Doolittle and Sapienza 1980 selfish genes
use_en: Argues that some DNA spreads because it can survive in genomes, without a function for the organism. Nature 284:601-603.
use_zh: 提出有些 DNA 只因能在基因组中存续而扩散，不必对生物体有功能。Nature 284:601-603。
note: April 1980 volume 284; not the December volume 288 correspondence.

name: Orgel and Crick 1980 selfish DNA
use_en: Companion essay on selfish DNA as sequences that spread within the genome. Nature 284:604-607.
use_zh: 同期关于自私 DNA 的文章：一些序列因能在基因组内扩散而存在。Nature 284:604-607。
note: April 1980 volume 284. Do not use 10.1038/288604a0 (that DOI is a different paper).

name: Orgel, Crick and Sapienza 1980 selfish DNA reply
use_en: December 1980 Nature correspondence (288:645-646) on selfish DNA. A later reply, not a substitute for the April 1980 volume-284 essays.
use_zh: 1980 年 12 月 Nature 关于自私 DNA 的通信（288:645-646）。是后来的回复，不能代替同年 4 月第 284 卷的两篇文章。
note: Do not confuse with 10.1038/288604a0, which is a different paper.

name: Schnable et al. 2009 maize B73 genome
use_en: Maize B73 genome paper. EuropePMC abstract: 'Nearly 85% of the genome is composed of hundreds of families of transposable elements'.
use_zh: 玉米 B73 基因组论文。EuropePMC 摘要原句：Nearly 85% of the genome is composed of hundreds of families of transposable elements。

name: Kobayashi, Goto-Yamamoto and Hirochika 2004 grape skin color
use_en: Reports retrotransposon-induced mutations in grape skin color. The body was not re-read in this pass.
use_zh: 报道反转录转座子诱导的葡萄果皮颜色突变。正文本轮未重读。
note: Gret1/VvmybA1 names are taken from later abstracts (This et al. 2007), not from this body.

name: Kobayashi et al. 2005 VvmybA1 in skin-color mutants
use_en: Title-matched: Association of VvmybA1 Gene Expression with Anthocyanin Production in Grape (Vitis vinifera) Skin-color Mutants. Journal of the Japanese Society for Horticultural Science 74:196-203. The body was not opened in this pass.
use_zh: 题名已匹配：葡萄果皮颜色突变体中 VvmybA1 表达与花青素生成。Journal of the Japanese Society for Horticultural Science 74:196-203。正文本轮未打开。
note: Candidate source for the Ruby Okuyama / Gret1 intra-LTR recombination statement later restated in Azuma 2009 [待确认].

name: This et al. 2007 VvmybA1 and grape color
use_en: Gret1 insertion in the VvmybA1 promoter was strongly associated with white-fruited V. vinifera (abstract read). Some pigmented alleles were consistent with later “excision” (authors' word). Association was rarely absent. Solo-LTR structure of coloured alleles is [待确认].
use_zh: Gret1 插入 VvmybA1 启动子与欧亚葡萄白果表型密切相关（已读摘要）。部分有色等位基因与后来的“excision”（作者原词）相符。少数情况下看不到这一关联。有色等位是否为 solo LTR 标 [待确认]。

name: Azuma et al. 2009 bud-sport color recovery
use_en: Color recovery in bud sports of white-skinned Italia. The Ruby Okuyama / Gret1 intra-LTR recombination sentence restates earlier work (candidate: Kobayashi 2005, doi:10.2503/jjshs.74.196, body not opened) [待确认]. The paper's own Benitaka result is VvmybA1a–VvmybA3 recombination, not a TE.
use_zh: 白果 Italia 芽变恢复颜色。关于 Ruby Okuyama / Gret1 的 intra-LTR 重组一句是复述先前工作（候选：Kobayashi 2005，doi:10.2503/jjshs.74.196，正文未打开）[待确认]。该文自己关于 Benitaka 的结果是 VvmybA1a 与 VvmybA3 重组，不是 TE。

name: Slotkin and Martienssen 2007 TE epigenetic regulation
use_en: Review of overlapping epigenetic mechanisms that silence TEs. The abstract notes that TEs have served as building blocks for epigenetic phenomena at single genes and across larger chromosomal regions.
use_zh: 综述宿主用以沉默 TE 的多层表观机制。摘要写到，TE 也是单个基因以及更大染色体区域上表观现象的构件。

name: Matzke and Mosher 2014 RNA-directed DNA methylation
use_en: Review of RNA-directed DNA methylation (RdDM) as an epigenetic pathway in plants.
use_zh: 综述植物中 RNA 介导的 DNA 甲基化（RdDM）这一表观途径。

name: Velasco et al. 2007 heterozygous Pinot Noir genome
ver_src: history paper title-matched, online/issued year (no print date in Crossref), 2026-11-15 CST
use_en: Heterozygous Pinot Noir draft; genome size estimate 504.6 Mb; homologous chromosomes differ by 11.2% of their DNA (abstract).
use_zh: 杂合黑皮诺草图；基因组大小估计 504.6 Mb；同源染色体 DNA 相差 11.2%（摘要）。
note: No TE fraction taken from the abstract. Year is Crossref issued/online 2007 (no print date).

name: Liu et al. 2024 grapevine pangenome
use_en: Graph-based Grapepan v.1.0; 9,105,787 short variants and 236,449 SVs in 466 cultivars. Reported that, on average, 88.6% of the SVs overlapped TEs (overlap, not TE-insertion fraction).
use_zh: 图泛基因组 Grapepan v.1.0；466 个品种中有 9,105,787 个短变异和 236,449 个结构变异。报道平均 88.6% 的结构变异与 TE 重叠（是重叠，不是 TE 插入占比）。
note: The 88.6% overlap sentence is not in the EuropePMC abstract; it is recorded from the literature review of the paper body (REVIEW_v1_4).

name: Wicker et al. 2007 unified classification
use_en: Hierarchical Class, order, superfamily and family system used throughout this repository, including the 80-80-80 family rule.
use_zh: 本仓库采用的层级分类（纲、目、超家族、家族），含 80-80-80 家族标准。
note: Primary source for the sequence-feature table.

name: Kapitonov and Jurka 2008 Repbase comment
use_en: Comment proposing a universal classification implemented in Repbase. Use it when comparing Wicker names with Repbase or RepeatMasker labels.
use_zh: 评论提出在 Repbase 中实现的通用分类，用于对照 Wicker 名称与 Repbase 或 RepeatMasker 标签。
note: This is a comment on Wicker et al. 2007, not a replacement paper.

name: Finnegan 1989 Class I and Class II
use_en: Classic split of eukaryotic TEs into Class I (RNA intermediate) and Class II (DNA intermediate).
use_zh: 将真核转座子分为第 I 类（RNA 中间体）和第 II 类（DNA 中间体）的经典划分。

name: Feschotte et al. 2002 plant TE review
use_en: Plant-centred review of TE types and how genetics meets genomics.
use_zh: 以植物为中心的转座子综述，说明遗传学与基因组学的交汇。

name: Lisch 2013 plant TE evolution
use_en: Review of the evolutionary importance of transposons in plants.
use_zh: 综述转座子在植物进化中的作用。

name: Bourque et al. 2018 ten things about TEs
use_en: Cross-kingdom primer on TE biology and common misconceptions.
use_zh: 跨界入门，讨论转座子生物学和常见误解。

name: Wells and Feschotte 2020 field guide
use_en: Field guide to eukaryotic TE diversity and classification.
use_zh: 真核转座子多样性与分类的导览。

name: How Wicker, Repbase/Dfam and REXdb names diverge (idea)
use_en: RepeatMasker or Dfam names are homology hits to a library. Wicker names are a structural hierarchy. TEsorter with REXdb assigns plant LTR lineages from protein domains. These three systems do not map 1:1.
use_zh: RepeatMasker 或 Dfam 名称是对文库的同源命中；Wicker 名称是结构层级；TEsorter 结合 REXdb 按蛋白结构域划分植物 LTR 谱系。三者不能一一对应。
out: a documented name mapping, not an automatic one
note: See docs/WORKFLOW.md. Do not replace a working FASTA with TEsorter all.cls.lib.

name: Kapitonov and Jurka 2001 Helitrons
use_en: Discovery paper for rolling-circle Helitron transposons.
use_zh: 滚环 Helitron 转座子的发现论文。
note: Termini: typically 5-prime TC and 3-prime CTRR with a short hairpin; usually no TSD.

name: Kapitonov and Jurka 2007 Helitrons on a roll
use_en: Review of Helitron structure and rolling-circle transposition.
use_zh: 综述 Helitron 结构与滚环转座。

name: Jaillon et al. 2007 grapevine genome
use_en: First grapevine genome paper. Use it as historical context, not as a current TE annotation.
use_zh: 首篇葡萄基因组论文。用作历史背景，不是当前的 TE 注释。
note: Jaillon et al. 2007 report that 41.4% (average of three approaches) of the PN40024 assembly is repetitive/transposable elements. That figure is the combined repetitive/TE fraction, not a TE-only proportion, and is not a current annotation.

name: Nested and fragmented TEs (idea)
use_en: Young insertions into older copies, and decayed fragments, break structural detectors and can be over-split by homology annotation.
use_zh: 新插入套在旧拷贝里，以及退化片段，会让结构检测失效，也可能被同源注释过度拆开。
note: Use structural plus homology evidence, then curation; RepeatCraft or oneCodeToFindThemAll can help defragment RepeatMasker output.

name: Recent versus old copies (idea)
use_en: Intact young LTR copies support insertion-age estimates; old fragments do not. Do not convert divergence to years without an explicit rate and generation time, and do not treat ages from raw EDTA as a delivery.
use_zh: 完整的年轻 LTR 拷贝才适合估计插入时间；古老片段不行。没有明确替换率和世代时间时，不要把分歧度换算成年代，也不要把原始 EDTA 的年龄当作交付结果。
out: p-distance or K2P; years only with a stated rate
note: scripts/01_ltr_insertion_age.py reports distances and leaves years as NA by default.

name: Curation bottleneck (idea)
use_en: Building a trusted library still needs expert checks even when TEtrimmer, MCHelper or Earl Grey automate parts of curation.
use_zh: 即使 TEtrimmer、MCHelper 或 Earl Grey 能自动完成部分整理，可信文库仍需要专家核对。
note: Goubert et al. 2022 is the beginner curation guide cited here.

name: False positives from genes and tandem repeats (idea)
use_en: Gene families, NLR clusters, SSRs and tandem repeats can enter a de novo library. CDS-gate the trusted set. Keep TRF, telomere and rDNA on a separate non-TE track.
use_zh: 基因家族、NLR 簇、简单重复和串联重复可能进入 de novo 文库。对 trusted 集合做 CDS 门控。TRF、端粒和 rDNA 放在单独的非 TE 轨道。
out: trusted lib plus a non-TE track
note: Non-TE repeats are not --curatedlib.

name: Soft-mask hand-off to gene annotation (idea)
use_en: Gene prediction (BRAKER, GALBA) should receive a soft-masked genome made with the current trusted library only. Do not hard-mask.
use_zh: 基因预测（BRAKER、GALBA）只应使用当前 trusted 文库做软屏蔽后的基因组。不要硬屏蔽。
note: Public hand-off: gene-structure-annotation docs/TE_LIBRARY.md. A0 accepts a named file with version and sha256.

name: Pangenome TE presence or absence (idea)
use_en: Haplotype-specific insertions are expected in grape. Combine libraries with panEDTA after a trusted file exists; do not concatenate raw TElibs and call that a pan library.
use_zh: 葡萄中会出现单倍型特异的插入。有 trusted 文件之后用 panEDTA 合并文库；不要把原始 TElib 直接拼接当作泛文库。
inp: per-haplotype EDTA results, trusted lib, CDS
note: See the panEDTA catalogue row for the designated citation (Ou et al. 2024 Genome Research). Combine with panEDTA after a trusted file exists; do not concatenate raw TElibs.

name: Heterozygous and haplotype-resolved grape genomes (idea)
use_en: Run discovery per assembly or haplotype. Do not collapse haplotypes before TE discovery, and do not treat a collapsed primary assembly as both haplotypes.
use_zh: 按每个组装或单倍型做发现。发现之前不要把单倍型塌缩，也不要把塌缩后的主组装当成两个单倍型。
note: Follows the public vitis-te pipeline already on main.

name: EDTA
use_en: Default de novo starting point in this repository. Run per assembly or haplotype with --species others --sensitive 1 --anno 1 and set --u explicitly (no grape default is supplied here).
use_zh: 本仓库默认的 de novo 起点。对每个组装或单倍型运行，使用 --species others --sensitive 1 --anno 1，并记录 --u。
inp: genome FASTA; optional CDS and curatedlib
note: Ou et al. 2019 Genome Biology. Raw TElib is not a trusted library and is not --curatedlib. Version not pinned. If --u is omitted, EDTA uses a rice rate of 1.3e-8 /bp/year; do not use that default silently for grape. A grape --u is [待确认].

name: EDTA tutorial (Su et al. 2021)
use_en: Step-by-step EDTA tutorial in Methods in Molecular Biology.
use_zh: Methods in Molecular Biology 中的 EDTA 逐步教程。

name: RepeatModeler2
use_en: De novo family discovery (RECON, RepeatScout and LTR structural steps). Use as an alternative or complement, then curate before masking.
use_zh: de novo 家族发现（含 RECON、RepeatScout 和 LTR 结构步骤）。可作为备选或补充，屏蔽前仍需整理。
note: Flynn et al. 2020 PNAS. Raw consensi are not a trusted gene-purged library.

name: Earl Grey
use_en: Automated annotation pipeline built around RepeatModeler and further curation helpers.
use_zh: 以 RepeatModeler 和后续整理模块为主的自动注释流程。
note: Baril et al. 2024. Still apply a CDS gate before gene soft-mask.

name: RepeatScout
use_en: Seed-based de novo repeat family finder; used inside RepeatModeler.
use_zh: 基于种子的 de novo 重复家族发现，RepeatModeler 的组成部分。
note: Price et al. 2005.

name: RECON
use_en: De novo identification of repeat families from pairwise alignments; used inside RepeatModeler.
use_zh: 从两两比对中识别重复家族，RepeatModeler 的组成部分。
note: Bao and Eddy 2002. Software URL not independently confirmed in this pass; DOI is the methods paper.

name: PILER
use_en: De novo identification and classification of genomic repeats.
use_zh: 基因组重复序列的 de novo 识别与分类。
note: Edgar and Myers 2005.

name: LTR_FINDER
use_en: Structural predictor of full-length LTR retrotransposons. Often run as input to LTR_retriever.
use_zh: 全长 LTR 反转录转座子的结构预测，常作为 LTR_retriever 的输入。
note: Xu and Wang 2007.

name: LTR_FINDER_parallel
use_en: Parallel wrapper for LTR_FINDER, used in EDTA.
use_zh: LTR_FINDER 的并行封装，EDTA 中使用。
note: Ou and Jiang 2019 Mobile DNA 10:48.

name: LTRharvest
use_en: Structural LTR detector in GenomeTools; often paired with LTR_retriever.
use_zh: GenomeTools 中的 LTR 结构检测，常与 LTR_retriever 联用。
note: Ellinghaus et al. 2008.

name: LTR_retriever
use_en: Filters structural LTR candidates, builds intact LTR sets, and can report LTR-LTR divergence for age.
use_zh: 过滤结构预测得到的 LTR 候选，生成完整 LTR 集合，并可根据 LTR-LTR 分歧度估计插入时间。
out: intact LTR list, library, optional ages
note: Ou and Jiang 2018. Convert to years only with an explicit --u or equivalent rate.

name: HelitronScanner
use_en: Structural detector for Helitrons using the 5-prime TC and 3-prime CTRR-like local context.
use_zh: 根据 5 端 TC 和 3 端 CTRR 一类局部特征检测 Helitron。
note: Xiong et al. 2014.

name: MITE-Hunter
use_en: De novo discovery of MITEs from genomic sequences.
use_zh: 从基因组序列中 de novo 发现 MITE。
note: Han and Wessler 2010. Software homepage not independently confirmed in this pass; DOI is the methods paper.

name: detectMITE
use_en: Numerical method for MITE detection.
use_zh: 用数值方法检测 MITE。
note: Ye et al. 2016.

name: TIR-Learner
use_en: Ensemble method for TIR DNA transposon annotation, used inside EDTA.
use_zh: TIR DNA 转座子注释的集成方法，EDTA 中使用。
note: Su et al. 2019 Molecular Plant.

name: Generic Repeat Finder (GRF)
use_en: Sensitive detector of TIRs, TDRs, MITEs and related terminal-repeat structures.
use_zh: 高灵敏度检测 TIR、TDR、MITE 及相关末端重复结构。
note: Shi and Liang 2019.

name: RepeatMasker
use_en: Homology annotation and soft-masking (-xsmall) against a chosen library. For gene annotation, use only the current trusted, gene-purged library.
use_zh: 用选定文库做同源注释和软屏蔽（-xsmall）。用于基因注释时，只使用当前经过基因清洗的 trusted 文库。
note: No standalone RepeatMasker software paper. Official citation: Smit, AFA, Hubley, R & Green, P. RepeatMasker Open-4.0. 2013-2015 http://www.repeatmasker.org. Cite Dfam or Repbase for the library.

name: Dfam (Storer et al. 2021)
use_en: Open community resource of TE families, HMMs and annotations. Names are library hits, not a Wicker assignment by themselves.
use_zh: 开放的 TE 家族、HMM 和注释资源。名称是文库命中，本身不等于 Wicker 分类。
note: Plant coverage is uneven compared with specialised plant LTR resources such as REXdb.

name: Dfam (Hubley et al. 2016)
use_en: Earlier Dfam methods paper describing the database of repetitive DNA families.
use_zh: 较早的 Dfam 方法论文，介绍重复 DNA 家族数据库。

name: Repbase Update
use_en: Long-standing commercial/academic database of eukaryotic repeats, historically used by RepeatMasker.
use_zh: 长期使用的真核重复序列数据库，RepeatMasker 历史上常用。
note: Jurka et al. 2005. Access terms are set by GIRI; this catalogue only records the methods paper and the project URL.

name: TEsorter
use_en: Classify plant LTR retrotransposon lineages from protein domains, typically with rexdb-plant. Domain labels for some TIR and Helitron sequences may also be emitted [待确认 for exact class coverage]. Use labels and the domain table only.
use_zh: 根据蛋白结构域划分植物 LTR 谱系，常用 rexdb-plant。也可给部分 TIR 和 Helitron 打结构域标签 [待确认具体覆盖范围]。只使用标签和结构域表。
note: Zhang et al. 2022. Never replace the working FASTA with all.cls.lib.

name: REXdb
use_en: Plant LTR domain phylogeny and lineage framework used by TEsorter. Finer lineage names (for example Ale, SIRE, Tekay, CRM) apply to LTR elements.
use_zh: TEsorter 使用的植物 LTR 结构域系统发育和谱系框架。更细的谱系名称（如 Ale、SIRE、Tekay、CRM）适用于 LTR。
note: Neumann et al. 2019. Lineage names (for example Ale, SIRE, Tekay, CRM) are more resolved than a generic LTR/Gypsy hit.

name: DeepTE
use_en: CNN classifier for unknown TE consensus sequences. Complements, and does not replace, structural classification or library curation.
use_zh: 用卷积神经网络对未知 TE consensus 分类。是结构分类和文库整理的补充，不能替代它们。
note: Yan et al. 2020.

name: TEclass
use_en: Support-vector classifier for unknown eukaryotic TEs.
use_zh: 用支持向量机对未知真核转座子分类。
note: Abrusan et al. 2009. Software homepage not independently confirmed in this pass; DOI is the methods paper.

name: TEtrimmer
use_en: Automates much of manual consensus curation (extend, align, cluster, define boundaries). In this repository: run per haplotype, merge Perfect and Good, then CD-HIT to a working library.
use_zh: 自动完成大量人工 consensus 整理（延伸、比对、聚类、界定边界）。在本仓库中：按单倍型运行，合并 Perfect 与 Good，再用 CD-HIT 生成 working 文库。
note: Qian et al. 2025. Do not overwrite the working library with an optional 80-80 family catalog.

name: MCHelper
use_en: Automated helper for curating TE libraries across eukaryotes.
use_zh: 帮助整理真核 TE 文库的自动化工具。
note: Orozco-Arias et al. 2024. Still apply a CDS gate before gene soft-mask.

name: Goubert et al. 2022 manual curation guide
use_en: Beginner guide to manual TE curation; use alongside automated trimmers.
use_zh: 转座子人工整理入门指南，可与自动修剪工具一起使用。

name: CD-HIT
use_en: Cluster consensus sequences (this repository uses about 95 percent identity for the working library). Deduplication is not curation.
use_zh: 对 consensus 序列聚类（本仓库 working 文库约用 95% 相似度）。去冗余不等于整理。
note: Fu et al. 2012. cat plus CD-HIT of many raw libraries is not --curatedlib.

name: Tandem Repeats Finder (TRF)
use_en: Detect tandem repeats. Keep them on a non-TE track; they do not belong in --curatedlib.
use_zh: 检测串联重复。放在非 TE 轨道，不属于 --curatedlib。
note: Benson 1999.

name: LTR Assembly Index (LAI)
use_en: Assembly-quality index based on intact LTR content. Compute after curated or pan TE annotations, not on raw EDTA output alone.
use_zh: 基于完整 LTR 含量的组装质量指标。应在整理后或泛 TE 注释上计算，不要只用原始 EDTA 输出。
note: Ou et al. 2018 Nucleic Acids Research. Distributed with LTR_retriever.

name: BEDTools
use_en: Interval arithmetic for TE and gene tracks, useful when checking library versus CDS overlaps.
use_zh: 用于 TE 与基因轨道的区间运算，便于检查文库与 CDS 重叠。
note: Quinlan and Hall 2010.

name: Soft-mask hand-off (this repository)
use_en: Soft-mask only, with the current trusted library, then hand the genome to gene-structure-annotation. scripts/02_softmask.py is a toy demonstration of lowercasing BED intervals.
use_zh: 只用当前 trusted 文库做软屏蔽，再把基因组交给 gene-structure-annotation。scripts/02_softmask.py 是把 BED 区间改为小写的演示。
note: Do not hard-mask for BRAKER or GALBA.

name: TEMP
use_en: Call TE insertion polymorphisms from short-read data against a reference TE annotation.
use_zh: 用短读数据和参考 TE 注释检测插入多态。
note: Zhuang et al. 2014. For population resequencing, not a substitute for de novo library construction.

name: RelocaTE2
use_en: Map TE insertion sites from population resequencing at high resolution, including TSD detection.
use_zh: 从群体重测序中高分辨率定位 TE 插入位点，并可检测 TSD。
note: Chen et al. 2017.

name: xTea
use_en: Identify TE insertions from short and long reads.
use_zh: 用短读和长读识别 TE 插入。
note: Chu et al. 2021. Long-read support is the reason to consider it alongside short-read callers.

name: Jitterbug
use_en: Call TE insertions from a BAM and a reference TE annotation, including zygosity estimates.
use_zh: 根据 BAM 和参考 TE 注释检测插入，并可估计合子性。
note: Henaff et al. 2015.

name: panEDTA
use_en: Official combine-and-reannotate step for a panel of genomes. Pass a trusted library with -l; do not concatenate raw TElibs.
use_zh: 对一组基因组做官方合并并重新注释。用 -l 传入 trusted 文库；不要直接拼接原始 TElib。
inp: genome list, CDS, optional trusted lib
note: panEDTA citation designated in the EDTA README: Ou et al. 2024 Genome Research 34:1140-1153 (maize TE variation paper). Distributed in the EDTA repository.

name: RepeatCraft
use_en: Defragment and tidy RepeatMasker annotations.
use_zh: 对 RepeatMasker 注释做碎片合并和整理。
note: Wong and Simakov 2019.

name: oneCodeToFindThemAll
use_en: Parse RepeatMasker output into elements rather than raw hits.
use_zh: 把 RepeatMasker 输出解析成元件，而不是原始命中。
note: Bailly-Bechet et al. 2014.

name: gene-structure-annotation TE_LIBRARY.md
use_en: Public hand-off document for what gene annotation may soft-mask with. This repository does not duplicate that playbook.
use_zh: 基因注释软屏蔽交接的公开说明。本仓库不重复那份操作手册。
note: Overlap with gene-structure-annotation is expected; cross-link rather than copy.
